from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1]
    rbounds = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)]
    cbounds = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    interior = [grid[r][c] for ra, rb in zip(rbounds, rbounds[1:]) for ca, cb in zip(cbounds, cbounds[1:]) for r in range(ra+1, rb) for c in range(ca+1, cb)]
    bg = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = Counter(x for x in interior if x != bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(rbounds, rbounds[1:]):
        line = []
        for ca, cb in zip(cbounds, cbounds[1:]):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(ra+1, rb) for c in range(ca+1, cb))
            line.append(1 if n == 2 else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out
